units.source_text: 真一不信千重子是个弃儿，更无法相信她是捡来的。

en.t: Shinichi did not believe that Chieko was an abandoned child, and he could believe even less that she had been found and taken in.

units.source_text: 千重子的家坐落在古老的批发商店街，只需在附近一打听，很快就能了解底细。

en.t: Chieko's house stood in an old wholesale district, and if one simply asked around nearby, the truth could soon be found out.

units.source_text: 可是，真一眼下压根儿就不想去调查。

en.t: But for the moment, Shinichi had absolutely no desire to investigate.

units.source_text: 他有点迷惑，很想了解千重子为什么要在此时此地作这番表白。

en.t: He was somewhat bewildered, and very much wanted to understand why Chieko had made such a confession at this time and in this place.
